description_en: Ignores the evaluation results of a rule for specific resources. You can also set a time period to ignore the rule. When the ignore period expires, the system automatically resumes displaying the evaluation results of the rule for the resources
description_zh: 忽略某条规则对某些资源的评估结果。您还可以设置规则的忽略时间，当忽略到期后，自动恢复显示该规则对资源的检测结果
kebab_example: aliyun config ignore-evaluation-results --config-rule-id cr-7e72626622af00510000 --resources ResourceId=lb-hp3a3b4ztyfm2plgm0000 Region=cn-beijing ResourceType=ACS::SLB::LoadBalancer ResourceAccountId=1009318965420000 --reason '无需检测。' --ignore-date 2022-06-01 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: IgnoreEvaluationResults
